target.new_string:
## Structure map

Entry points: backend `services/rag_engine/routers/api.py` (create_app, lifespan); routes in `routers/query.py` (`/v1/query`, `/v1/query/stream`, `/v1/retrieve`), `routers/documents.py`, `routers/ops.py` (`/v1/index/status`). Frontend `web/src/components/RagWorkspace.tsx` (Ask) and `IndexStorageStudio.tsx` (Index & storage), via `web/src/services/api.ts`.

Core files: `agent/graph.py` (LangGraph retrieve→sufficiency→generate→verify→reformulate), `retrieval/hybrid.py` (dense+BM25+RRF+rerank), `ingestion/pipeline.py` (transactional ingest), `vector_store.py` (Qdrant), `graph_store.py` (Neo4j/in-memory), `index_inspector.py` (live reads).

Dependency graph: Frontend RagWorkspace → api.query/retrieve → query.py → agent graph → HybridRetriever (Qdrant+BM25) + graph traversal + LLM. Ingestion: documents.py → pipeline → parse/chunk → graph_store.extract_and_store → vector_store.upsert → storage save → manifest. Startup hydrates Qdrant+graph from disk.

Impact radius: vector_store schema requires reindex; chunker versions affect manifest/boot; pipeline transactional flow affects rollback; hybrid RankedChunk contract consumed by graph/query/frontend; graph_store in-memory shape relied on by pipeline rollback and graph traversal; `_state.py` LiveRef seams used by tests; api.ts types consumed by components.

## Health

Tests: extensive backend (`test_query_pipeline`, `test_agent_graph`, `test_retrieval`, `test_transactional_ingestion`, `test_index_inspector`, `test_qdrant_store`, graph tests) and frontend (`RagWorkspace.test.tsx` 905 lines, `IndexStorageStudio.test.tsx` 366 lines, `api.test.ts` 450 lines). No TODO/FIXME in target paths.

Coverage gaps: no direct unit tests for `bm25.py`/`fusion.py`/`hybrid.py` (indirect only); Neo4j paths in graph_store need live service; pipeline `clear_all`, rollback restore, hydration, reindex limited; index_inspector helper/SQL edge cases.

Type issues: `Any` pervasive in index_inspector.py; `list[Any]` vectors in pipeline; `dict[str, Any]` in vector_store/graph_store; `driver: object | None` instead of typed Neo4j driver. Frontend target files contain no `any`.

Dead code: `KnowledgeGraphStore.query_entity_neighborhood` is an internal alias of `query_neighborhood` (only latter used externally); otherwise no obvious dead exports.

## History / hotspots

Top churn: rag_engine dir 142; app.py 39; api.py 27; RagWorkspace 25; pipeline 24; hybrid 22; documents 16; api.ts 15; vector_store 13; graph.py 11; query.py 11; graph_store 11; index_inspector 6; IndexStorageStudio 6.

Hotspots (churn × fix ratio): documents.py (16 commits, 14 fix, 88%); query.py (11, 8, 73%); pipeline.py (24, 15, 63%); RagWorkspace (25, 11, 44%); app.py (39, 18, 46%); hybrid (22, 8, 36%).

Recent relevant changes: stream queue fixes (unbounded queues, error-only termination, retrieval_ready ordering, per-stage timings in retrieval_complete), session_id support, sync/stream finalization parity, live index status polling (F-23), trace id/review status in QueryResponse, refusal vs degraded verdict precedence, serving provenance.

## Main flow trace

Query: RagWorkspace.handleQuery → api.query → POST /v1/query → query_endpoint (index gate, trace, input guardrails) → agent_graph.ainvoke: retrieve (embed→Qdrant+BM25→RRF→rerank→penalty; graph traversal if enabled) → check_sufficiency → generate (prompt+LLM, streaming via token_sink) → verify (citations) → route (end / reformulate-retry / finish_failed) → output guardrails → QueryResponse (answer, chunks, entities, cycle_count, verified, refusal, serving, timings, usage, trace).

Ingestion: POST /v1/documents → upload_documents_endpoint → pipeline.ingest_file (size check, parse, digest, dedup) → chunker → graph_store.extract_and_store (NER + Neo4j/in-memory) → _index_chunks (embed + Qdrant upsert + count verify) → storage.save_document → manifest publish; rollback on any exception; post-ingest BM25 rebuild + consistency check.

Observability gap: backend already emits SSE frames (`retrieval_complete` with chunk_ids + timings_ms, `token`, `verification_complete`, `done`) via `/v1/query/stream`, but frontend `RagWorkspace` only calls non-streaming `api.query` and shows a single spinner; no live step indicator for retrieve/graph/generate/verify. IndexStorageStudio polls `/v1/index/status` but is a separate page, not tied to in-flight query/ingestion status.

## Real problems

### ISS-001: Ask flow is blocking; no live pipeline status
- Evidence: `web/src/components/RagWorkspace.tsx:141` handleQuery calls api.query; `web/src/services/api.ts:147` only query() exists; no frontend use of `/v1/query/stream`.
- Impact: During a request the UI shows only a spinner; retrieval (Qdrant+BM25), graph traversal (Neo4j), generation and verification progress is invisible.
- Severity: high. Confidence: high. Category: real-problem.
- Suggested direction: consume `/v1/query/stream` SSE and render step progress; keep blocking path as fallback.

### ISS-002: Streaming backend emits only retrieval+tokens; no graph/vector stage events
- Evidence: `services/rag_engine/routers/query.py:413` retrieval_complete event; `services/rag_engine/agent/graph.py` retrieve node performs Qdrant/BM25/graph traversal but no distinct SSE frames.
- Impact: Even if frontend streamed, it could not show Qdrant vs Neo4j vs BM25 stage progress.
- Severity: med. Confidence: high. Category: real-problem.
- Suggested direction: emit stage events (retrieve_dense, retrieve_sparse, graph_traversal, fusion, rerank, generate, verify) with timings.

### ISS-003: Ingestion endpoints are synchronous with no progress
- Evidence: `services/rag_engine/routers/documents.py:37` upload_documents_endpoint, `:109` ingest_document_endpoint return only after full pipeline; `services/ingestion/pipeline.py` runs parse→chunk→graph→vector→storage with no callbacks.
- Impact: Large uploads appear stuck; Qdrant/Neo4j work invisible during ingestion.
- Severity: med. Confidence: high. Category: real-problem.
- Suggested direction: add an SSE/progress endpoint or callback-based progress reporting for ingest stages.

### ISS-004: Index & storage health is isolated from Ask/ingestion flows
- Evidence: `web/src/App.tsx` routes `/sources/index` separately; `IndexStorageStudio.tsx` polls `/v1/index/status`; `RagWorkspace.tsx` has no store-health or in-flight linkage.
- Impact: Users must navigate away to see whether Qdrant/Neo4j are live; no correlation with an in-flight request.
- Severity: med. Confidence: high. Category: real-problem.
- Suggested direction: surface a compact live-status strip (Qdrant/Neo4j/BM25 reachability) in Ask and during ingestion.

### ISS-005: Loose typing in inspector and stores weakens observability contracts
- Evidence: `services/rag_engine/index_inspector.py` uses `Any` pervasively; `services/ingestion/vector_store.py` health() returns `dict[str, Any]`; `services/ingestion/graph_store.py` driver: object | None.
- Impact: Harder to extend status reporting safely; low direct user impact.
- Severity: low. Confidence: high. Category: style-nit.
- Suggested direction: introduce typed status models / Protocol for driver.

### ISS-006: Retrieval core (hybrid/bm25/fusion) lacks direct unit tests
- Evidence: tests list has no test_hybrid.py/test_bm25.py/test_fusion.py; only indirect via test_retrieval.py.
- Impact: Changes to make retrieval stages observable risk regressions with weak coverage.
- Severity: med. Confidence: high. Category: real-problem.
- Suggested direction: add characterization tests for fusion/RRF/hybrid before refactoring.

### ISS-007: Dead alias in graph store
- Evidence: `services/ingestion/graph_store.py` defines query_entity_neighborhood as internal alias of query_neighborhood; only query_neighborhood is called externally (`rag_engine/agent/graph.py`).
- Impact: Minor dead surface.
- Severity: low. Confidence: med. Category: style-nit.
- Suggested direction: remove alias if no external callers.

## Style nits

- KnowledgeGraphStore.query_entity_neighborhood alias (ISS-007).
- Any typing in inspector/stores (ISS-005).

target.new_string:
## Goals

- Make RAG/Neo4j/Qdrant work visible while using Ask: stream answers and show live stage progress (retrieve → generate → verify) with timings.
- Surface Qdrant/Neo4j/BM25 reachability on the Ask page instead of only on a separate Index page.
- Improve ingestion loading feedback to name the subsystems being worked (Qdrant vectors, Neo4j entities).

## Non-goals

- No rewrite of ingestion pipeline or storage backends.
- No new backend ingest SSE endpoint in this initiative (deferred; ingestion keeps synchronous endpoint with improved client-side progress).
- No changes to protected paths or data schemas.

## Constraints

- Keep blocking `/v1/query` path as fallback for retrieval-only and errors.
- Preserve existing component tests; no removal of coverage.
- Follow existing UI styling/tokens; no new dependencies.

## Options considered

| Option | Effort | Risk | Blast radius | Reversibility |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A: Frontend-only stream consumption | Low | Low | RagWorkspace only | High |
| B: Backend stage events + frontend stream + health strip | Med | Med | query.py + RagWorkspace + api.ts | Med |
| C: Full ingest SSE progress | High | High | documents.py + pipeline + IngestionStudio | Low |

Recommendation: B. It delivers visible RAG/Qdrant/Neo4j process with moderate risk and reuses existing SSE endpoint. C is deferred.

## Acceptance criteria

- Ask renders incremental answer tokens instead of waiting for full response.
- Ask shows stage progress (Retrieving, Generating, Verifying) with elapsed/timings.
- Ask shows a compact Qdrant/Neo4j/BM25 reachability strip.
- Ingestion loading pulse names Qdrant vectors and Neo4j entities.
- Existing backend/frontend tests pass (test_query_pipeline, RagWorkspace, IndexStorageStudio, api).

## Steps

### Step 1: Emit stage events in streaming backend
Files: services/rag_engine/routers/query.py
Verify: uv run pytest tests/test_query_pipeline.py -q
Rollback: revert query.py stream edits; keep retrieval_complete/token frames.

### Step 2: Add SSE client method to API client
Files: web/src/services/api.ts
Verify: npm --prefix web run test -- api.test.ts
Rollback: remove queryStream method; RagWorkspace falls back to api.query.

### Step 3: Consume stream in RagWorkspace with live stage progress
Files: web/src/components/RagWorkspace.tsx
Verify: npm --prefix web run test -- RagWorkspace.test.tsx
Rollback: revert handleQuery to api.query call.

### Step 4: Add compact store-health strip to Ask page
Files: web/src/components/RagWorkspace.tsx
Verify: npm --prefix web run test -- RagWorkspace.test.tsx
Rollback: remove health strip; Ask page unchanged.

### Step 5: Improve ingestion loading pulse wording
Files: web/src/components/IngestionStudio.tsx
Verify: npm --prefix web run test -- IngestionStudio.test.tsx
Rollback: restore original loading pulse text.
